queue.push

Adds a job to a queue and returns its identifier.

Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
queuestringyesName of the target queue.
payloadobjectyesArbitrary JSON delivered to the worker.
priorityintegerno0 to 9, default 5.
delay_msintegernoWait before the job becomes runnable.

Errors

queue_full
The queue holds its maximum number of waiting jobs.
payload_too_large
The payload exceeds 256 KiB after serialisation.
unknown_queue
No queue with that name exists in the workspace.

Example response

{
  "id": "job_8f2c1a",
  "queue": "emails",
  "state": "waiting"
}
